# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.

Spec locations (attach them as context when relevant):
- `docs/plan.md` — MVP spec and API contract (source of truth)
- `specs/features/F-00X-*/spec.md` — per-feature specs (intent, behavior, edge cases, acceptance criteria)
- `docs/progress.md` — what is already implemented
- `docs/runbook.md` — ordered task checklist with checkpoints
- `openspec/` — specs created with OpenSpec (if used)
